name: Boku to Kanojo no Yuganda Kankei
original_name: 僕と彼女の歪んだ関係
source:
A shadow stalking the one I love. Play with the girls who inconsistently want to protect themselves, but want to get swept off their feet at the same time. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036274.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有个阴影一直跟踪我所爱的人。与这些女孩相处吧：她们有时想保护自己，有时又希望被人彻底征服。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036274.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
